title: Keep team chat inside the Game-owned Match
why: Chat needs authorization, validation and a destination. In this release the Game service owns Match team chat; a durable Chat service is deferred. Start with scope and limits before adding its socket.
outcome: Validate messages and quick pings, derive sender and room from the trusted principal, cap per-team history, and state that history is process-local.

steps.title: A message enters one authorized team room
steps.question: Who chooses sender and recipient room?
explanation: The trusted socket principal tells the server who sent the event. The Game checks Match membership and side, validates content and rate, then broadcasts to that team. History is bounded in memory for this release; it is not durable.

steps.title: Derive the team room from membership
steps.question: What must happen before broadcast?
explanation: In src/server/chat.gateway.ts, require the attached socket principal, ask Game for the player’s Match side, join only that team room, and send bounded history. Reject strangers before returning history or publishing an entry.
hints: Read the principal attached during handshake.
Resolve membership from Game state.
Choose a room from trusted Match and side.
Only then read history or emit the validated message.

steps.title: Merge live messages with reconnect history
steps.question: How do you avoid showing a message twice after reconnect?
explanation: In src/client/chat-client.ts, keep one seen-id Set for both live events and reconnect history. Add each incoming entry only once, notify the view, and remove socket listeners when the client disconnects.
